module subtract_8bit (
    input signed [7:0] a, b,
    output signed [8:0] diff
);

    wire signed [7:0] b_comp = ~b + 1; // Compute two's complement of b
    wire signed [8:0] sum = a + b_comp; // Add a and two's complement of b

    assign diff = sum; // The result is automatically signed with 9 bits

endmodule

module TopModule (
  input clk,
  input reset,
  output reg [3:0] q
);

  always @(posedge clk) begin
    if (reset) begin
      q <= 4'b0;
    end else begin
      if (q == 4'd9) begin
        q <= 4'b0;
      end else begin
        q <= q + 1'b1;
      end
    end
  end

endmodule

module TopModule (
  input clk,
  input resetn,
  input [1:0] byteena,
  input [15:0] d,
  output reg [15:0] q
);

  always @(posedge clk) begin
    if (!resetn) begin
      q <= 16'b0;
    end else begin
      case (byteena)
        2'b01: q[7:0] <= d[7:0];
        2'b10: q[15:8] <= d[15:8];
        default: ; // No update for other byteena values
      endcase
    end
  end

endmodule

module TopModule (
  input [3:0] in,
  output out_and,
  output out_or,
  output out_xor
);

  assign out_and = ∈       // AND of all input bits
  assign out_or  = |in;       // OR of all input bits
  assign out_xor = ^in;       // XOR of all input bits

endmodule

module TopModule (
  input [7:0] in,
  output reg [2:0] pos
);

  always @* begin
    pos = 3'b000; // Default assignment
    for (integer i = 0; i < 8; i = i + 1) begin
      if (in[i]) begin
        pos = i[2:0];
      end
    end
  end

endmodule

module TopModule (
  input  [3:0] in,
  output [3:0] out_both,
  output [3:0] out_any,
  output [3:0] out_different
);

  assign out_both = in & in;  // Bitwise AND of each bit with itself (result: 0 except LSB)
  assign out_any = in | in;  // Bitwise OR of each bit with itself (result: all 1s)
  assign out_different = in ^ in; // Bitwise XOR of each bit with itself (result: 0 except LSB)

endmodule

module TopModule (
  input a,
  input b,
  input c,
  input d,
  output reg out
);

  always @(*) begin
    out = (a ^ b) ^ (c ^ d);
  end

endmodule

module TopModule (
  input x,
  input y,
  output z
);

endmodule

module adder_bcd (
    input  [3:0] A,   // First BCD number (0-9)
    input  [3:0] B,   // Second BCD number (0-9)
    input  Cin,       // Input carry
    output [3:0] Sum, // BCD sum (0-9)
    output Cout       // Output carry
);
    wire [3:0] B_adder = B ^ {4{Cin}}; // Increment B by 1 (using addition with carry)
    wire [4:0] sum_temp = A + B_adder + Cin;
    
    assign Sum = sum_temp[3:0];        // Lower 4 bits as sum
    assign Cout = sum_temp[4];         // Carry-out from MSB
endmodule

module comparator_4bit(
    input [3:0] A,   // First 4-bit input operand
    input [3:0] B,   // Second 4-bit input operand
    output A_greater, 
    output A_equal,   
    output A_less     
);

    assign A_greater = (A > B);    // A is strictly greater than B
    assign A_equal   = (A == B);   // A is strictly equal to B
    assign A_less    = (A < B);    // A is strictly less than B

endmodule

module counter_12 
(
  input rst_n,
  input clk,
  input valid_count,

  output reg [3:0] out
);

  always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
    if (!rst_n) begin
      out <= 4'b0;
    end
    else begin
      if (valid_count) begin
        if (out == 4'd11)
          out <= 4'b0;
        else
          out <= out + 1;
      end
    end
  end

endmodule
